Publishing on GitHub

Source: PUBLISHING.md

The repository is ready to publish after choosing the GitHub account or organization that will own it.

  1. Configure repository-specific links:

    Rscript tools/configure-github.R GITHUB_OWNER

  2. Run the local checks:

    R CMD build .
R CMD check --no-manual RobustSandwichRV_0.1.0.tar.gz

  3. Create an empty public repository named RobustSandwichRV, then push:

    git init
git add .
git commit -m "Initial pure-R RobustSandwichRV release"
git branch -M main
git remote add origin https://github.com/GITHUB_OWNER/RobustSandwichRV.git
git push -u origin main

The included workflows run R CMD check on Windows, macOS, and Linux and deploy the pkgdown site to the gh-pages branch. Enable GitHub Pages for that branch after the first successful site build.

Site built with pkgdown 2.2.1.
